description: Get a section of the Tennessee Code Annotated (T.C.A.) — Tennessee state law — by citation. "39-13-202" is first degree murder; "66-28-301" is the security-deposit statute. Accepts natural forms: "39-13-202", "T.C.A. 39-13-202", "Tenn. Code Ann. § 39-13-202". Returns the statutory text, catchline, chapter context, and the "Acts ..." legislative history when the text carries one — but NOT case-law digest ("Notes to Decisions"), which this pack excludes. IMPORTANT: this is a POINT-IN-TIME snapshot frozen at 2021-05-21 (release 76 of Public.Resource.Org's scan), not the current code — Tennessee's only current electronic TCA is behind a LexisNexis login/session wall this pack cannot reach (confirmed by Tennessee Court of Appeals litigation; see this pack's README). Every response states current_through explicitly. Also returns later_acts: a dated, linked overlay of every Public Chapter this pack's own home-built index (built from Tennessee General Assembly Effective Reports and bill text, since Tennessee publishes no citation-to-act index) shows touching this exact citation since the 2021-05-21 snapshot (Public Chapter number, General Assembly, bill id, link to the bill text) — NOT merged into the text, explicitly labelled so, with sessions_checked naming every Effective Report the index covers even when later_acts is empty. Use for "what does T.C.A. 39-13-202 say" or to check a Tennessee statute AND whether it has been amended since 2021-05-21. All 68 published titles are covered. Keyless.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "39-13-202" (murder) or "66-28-301" (security deposits). Title-chapter-section; the title is the part before the first dash.
